title: Before a push, the guard checks the Red-run line on each test commit it sends
why: Incident, lane page-reply-uncollapse, 2026-11-07 03:30 CST, relayed by the coordinator 03:27 CST: test-file commit 1f35b617 was pushed with no `Red-run:` line. The gap showed only at `merge --lane-lint`, after the push, so the only fix was a replacement PR for #1345. Second incident, lane pr-state-is-on-the-pr, 2026-11-07 13:28 CST: commit af063548b was pushed to report-pass-needs-record with a malformed `Red-run:` line, because check_red_run ran after the push. The fix needed a new branch, since a force push is the owner's act. So the guard must also refuse a malformed line, not only a missing one.
note: Before a `git push`, the guard runs lint/check_red_run.py against the base for the commits the push sends. Cost: one git log and one diff read per push. Depends on step commit-refuses-conflict-markers, which builds the push-time check of the sent commits; this step extends that same home (building-one-home-per-capability). Done check: a red test on a push of a test commit with no Red-run line. The guard's verdict changes, so this is a build lane (test-author, builder, reviewer). No owner question. Absorbs proposed step red-run-at-commit (lane notes-fix-large-3, 18:04 CST Nov 7): 58bc56a3b and 435bafefb were pushed with `Red-run: none (...)`, a revert did not clear it, and #1631/#1632 replaced #1535/#1605. A push-time check stops that form before it lands; add a test that `Red-run: none (x)` is refused and `Red-run: none: x` allowed. Incident, Nov 7 23:14 CST (lane notes-fix-page, session_013NEJKzjkypcToggneCjJN8): a comment edit to a test file was pushed with no Red-run trailer (404b68a67 on #1482). Lane lint caught it only after the push, so the fix needed replacement PR #1785. Open PR #1582 (Refuse a push that sends a test commit with no valid Red-run trailer) builds this guard. Sighting (lane silent-undo-reads-retire-run, 04:50 CST Nov 8): db10b8d6b committed a test-file edit with no Red-run line, and only CI's check_red_run would have caught it. The lane proposed step red-run-at-commit, a commit-time hook running check_red_run's trailer test; triage folded it here, since this guard stops the same commit before it leaves the machine.
